title: Three-generation care network
goal: A reader can distinguish a three-generation family from the external people who support the identified child and parent.

rubric.must: 偉明 and 美玲 appear above 建國 and 麗華, who appear above 小安, in three distinct family generations.
建國 and 麗華 are connected as the parents of 小安, and 偉明 and 美玲 are connected as the parents of 麗華 only — 建國 married in and hangs off no sibship line.
學校輔導員 陳老師, 個案社工 王女士 and 鄰居 張阿姨 use a visibly distinct external-contact symbol treatment from family members.
The three labeled support links are visibly different from the solid partnership and parent-child structure lines and do not imply biological descent.
小安 visibly connects to 學校輔導員 陳老師 and 鄰居 張阿姨, while 麗華 visibly connects to 個案社工 王女士, and each of the three links carries its label (學校支持 / 個案支持 / 鄰里照顧).
All person and support-contact labels are written in Traditional Chinese, remain legible, and do not overlap symbols or lines.

ideal.notes: 偉明與美玲是麗華的父母，建國與麗華是焦點人物小安的父母；建國沒有連到上一代的子女支線。虛線菱形標示三位外部聯絡人，小安以雙線弧線連到學校輔導員 陳老師（學校支持）及鄰居 張阿姨（鄰里照顧），麗華以虛線弧線連到個案社工 王女士（個案支持）。
